note: City of Baxter Springs park (Riverside West) beside the Spring River below the dam, on Route 66; paved back-in pads, about 10 of them full hookup; train noise at night. CAMPER-REPORTED RATE: $15 with water and electric, $20 full hookup (Campendium and RV Life stays, November 2025 to October 2026); the city page posts no rate (2026-11-06). --Claude
summary: City Parks page confirms 24 RV spots with water/electric, some full hookup (manual); no rate, season or booking on any city page, so fees left empty and the 2025-26 camper-reported $15/$20 dated in the note; dump cleared (aggregator only); pin ~140 m north of the campground.
flags: WEBSITE: replace the bare city root https://baxterspringsks.gov/ with the Parks page that describes the campground: https://baxterspringsks.gov/171/Parks
PHONE 620-856-2114 confirmed (city page and Google 'Baxter Springs Campground').

PIN (optional, under 250 m): stored 37.02319,-94.72229 is the Riverside West entrance off US 166; Google 'Baxter Springs Campground' (37.02202,-94.72169) and Campendium (37.021972,-94.721717) put the RV spots ~140 m south. Suggested 37.0220,-94.7217.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept, riverview possible. The Spring River (~80-100 m wide here, a river) runs ~50-70 m east of the camp road through a continuous tree/brush band (Esri, NAIP 2026-11-06), with the park road between the pads and the bank. Only a Campendium review claims 'set back from the river but still have a view'; no official photo, so no view class written (go down).
FLOOD history: no city statement found (city alerts AID 10-14 and the Parks page are silent); the park sits in the Spring River bottom just below the dam. Not verified.

RATE: camper reports only ($15 W/E, $20 FHU, dated 11/2025-10/2026) - under the camper-report rule they cannot price the entry because the city has a page, so fees stay empty. Booking: Campendium says first come with a camp host collecting fees and a 3-day limit; secondary only, not written.
Google 4.2/93 (local park; does not drive a drop).
